"""Catalogue management and stock."""

from __future__ import annotations

from orders.application.errors import Conflict, ProductNotFound
from orders.domain.catalog import Product
from orders.infrastructure.catalog import InMemoryProductCatalog

class CatalogService:
    def __init__(self, catalog: InMemoryProductCatalog, stock: InMemoryStockRepository) -> None:
        self._catalog = catalog
        self._stock = stock

    def add_product(self, sku: str, name: str, unit_price_cents: int, on_hand: int = 0) -> Product:
        if self._catalog.get(sku) is not None:
            raise Conflict(f"product {sku} already exists")
        product = Product(sku, name, unit_price_cents)
        self._catalog.add(product)
        self._stock.set(sku, on_hand)
        return product

    def get_product(self, sku: str) -> Product:
        product = self._catalog.get(sku)

        return product

        return [p for p in self._catalog.list_all() if p.active]

----
import pytest

from orders.wiring import build_app


@pytest.fixture
def api():
    return build_app()


@pytest.fixture
def shop(api):
    """An app with two customers and three products in stock."""
    api.customers.handle_register({"customer_id": "c1", "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"})
    api.customers.handle_register({"customer_id": "c2", "name": "Grace", "email": "grace@example.com",
                                   "tier": "gold"})
    api.catalog.handle_add_product({"sku": "BOOK", "name": "Book", "unit_price_cents": 2_500, "on_hand": 50})
    api.catalog.handle_add_product({"sku": "LAMP", "name": "Lamp", "unit_price_cents": 6_000, "on_hand": 5})
    api.catalog.handle_add_product({"sku": "PEN", "name": "Pen", "unit_price_cents": 300, "on_hand": 100})
    return api
----
def order(api, customer_id="c1", *items):
    return api.orders.handle_create({"customer_id": customer_id,
                                     "items": [{"sku": s, "quantity": q} for s, q in items]})


def test_place_order_uses_catalogue_prices(shop):
    response = order(shop, "c1", ("BOOK", 2))
    assert response.status == 201
    assert response.body["items"] == [{"sku": "BOOK", "quantity": 2, "unit_price_cents": 2500}]
    assert response.body["order_id"] == "ord-0001"


def test_summary_applies_standard_and_gold_discounts(shop):
    standard = order(shop, "c1", ("LAMP", 2)).body["order_id"]
    gold = order(shop, "c2", ("LAMP", 2)).body["order_id"]
    assert shop.orders.handle_get(standard).body["discount_cents"] == 1200
    assert shop.orders.handle_get(gold).body["discount_cents"] == 1800
    assert shop.orders.handle_get(gold).body["total_cents"] == 10200


def test_no_discount_below_threshold(shop):
    oid = order(shop, "c1", ("BOOK", 3)).body["order_id"]
    assert shop.orders.handle_get(oid).body["discount_cents"] == 0


def test_stock_is_checked_and_decremented(shop):
    assert order(shop, "c1", ("LAMP", 6)).status == 409
    order(shop, "c1", ("LAMP", 5))
    assert shop.catalog.handle_get("LAMP").body["on_hand"] == 0


def test_cancel_restores_stock(shop):
    oid = order(shop, "c1", ("LAMP", 2)).body["order_id"]
    assert shop.orders.handle_cancel(oid).body["status"] == "cancelled"
    assert shop.catalog.handle_get("LAMP").body["on_hand"] == 5
    assert shop.orders.handle_cancel(oid).status == 409


def test_errors(shop):
    assert order(shop, "nobody", ("BOOK", 1)).status == 404
    assert order(shop, "c1", ("NOPE", 1)).status == 400
    assert shop.orders.handle_create({"customer_id": "c1", "items": []}).status == 400
    assert shop.orders.handle_get("ord-9999").status == 404
    assert shop.orders.handle_list_for_customer("nobody").status == 404


def test_list_for_customer_in_creation_order(shop):
    first = order(shop, "c1", ("BOOK", 1)).body["order_id"]
    order(shop, "c2", ("PEN", 1))
    second = order(shop, "c1", ("PEN", 2)).body["order_id"]
    body = shop.orders.handle_list_for_customer("c1").body
    assert [o["order_id"] for o in body["orders"]] == [first, second]

                 catalog: InMemoryProductCatalog, catalog_service: CatalogService) -> None:

        self._customers = customers
        self._catalog = catalog
        self._catalog_service = catalog_service

from __future__ import annotations

from orders.application.catalog_service import CatalogService
from orders.application.errors import Conflict, CustomerNotFound
from orders.application.order_service import OrderService
from orders.domain.fulfilment import PackingSlip, PackingSlipLine, StockLevel
from orders.infrastructure.catalog import InMemoryProductCatalog
from orders.infrastructure.customers import InMemoryCustomerRepository


class FulfilmentService:
    def __init__(self, orders: OrderService, customers: InMemoryCustomerRepository,
                 catalog: InMemoryProductCatalog, catalog_service: CatalogService) -> None:
        self._orders = orders
        self._customers = customers
        self._catalog = catalog
        self._catalog_service = catalog_service

    def packing_slip(self, order_id: str) -> PackingSlip:
        """Raises OrderNotFound, or Conflict if the order has been cancelled."""
        order = self._orders.get_order(order_id)
        if order.status == "cancelled":
            raise Conflict(f"order {order_id} is cancelled and cannot be packed")
        customer = self._customers.get(order.customer_id)
        if customer is None:
            raise CustomerNotFound(order.customer_id)
        lines = []
        for item in order.items:
            product = self._catalog.get(item.sku)
            name = product.name if product is not None else item.sku
            lines.append(PackingSlipLine(item.sku, name, item.quantity))
        return PackingSlip(order.order_id, customer.name, tuple(lines))

    def low_stock(self, threshold: int) -> list[StockLevel]:
        """Active products with on-hand stock strictly below ``threshold``, lowest stock first, then SKU."""
        levels = [StockLevel(p.sku, p.name, self._catalog_service.on_hand(p.sku))
                  for p in self._catalog_service.list_active()]
        return sorted((level for level in levels if level.on_hand < threshold),
                      key=lambda level: (level.on_hand, level.sku))
